thread:
dmitry: heads up — qbringup for q4b-variant produced some weird degradation on promptset-x. 5-10% drop in instruct accuracy on the golden slice. eval logs: https://internal.eval/runs/1748056789

ana: ugh. is this only quant vs fp16 or we also see topology/kv bias?

dmitry: mostly quant. int4 path. latency looks fine but hallucination and repetition up for longdialogs (~>512 tokens). attached a diff of model outputs for 6 failing prompts.

carla: can you paste the failing prompts inline? we should check dedupe/overlap with holdout and refset before we assume a model problem.

dmitry: pasted 6 examples in the run artifacts. quick embed-sim scan shows ~40% semantic overlap between the new seedbank and our refset (score > 0.88). might be sampling leakage.

eva: proposed plan: 1) rerun canary with prefix-caching disabled 2) do a semantic dedupe pass (min-sim=0.84) on the onboard samples 3) hand off 200 diverse items to labelers for golden-recheck using rubric v2

ana: I can coordinate labelers. need sampler SQL and a small script to attach provenance tags.

dmitry: sampler SQL (quick):
```
SELECT id, prompt, embed_sim FROM samples
WHERE cohort = 'q4b-onboard'
AND dedupe_score < 0.84
ORDER BY RAND()
LIMIT 200;
```
Add "provenance:onboard-q4b-<run>" tag after extraction.

carla: for labeling, use the golden_recheck rubric v2 (focus: factuality, instruction-following, hallucination severity). @eva can you paste the rubric link? :memo:

eva: https://redwood-internal/docs/golden_rubric/v2 — includes examples and pass/fail heuristics.

ben: also recommend a micro-ablation: run int4 with qscale=A vs qscale=B and int8 on the same 200 items. grab log-perf + token-level divergence. I'll queue the bench.

eva: noted. bench config: 6 repetitions, max_new_tokens=512, top_p=0.95, temperature=0.0 for deterministic comparison.

eval-bot: canary run queued (run_id=cb-1748056799). ETA ~2h. will post artifacts + delta table when done.

ana: tagging labelers — @labeler-miguel @labeler-lynn please standby for 200 items, target 24h turnaround. we'll split 100/100 and use the same rubric.

labeler-lynn: on it, will pick these up in morning shift and ping if anything ambiguous.

labeler-miguel: ok, will do a quick pass tonight on low-hanging cases.

dmitry: thanks all. if regressions persist after dedupe + bench ablation we'll rollback the quant profile and open a rollback PR with the canary hash and failing sample list. update this thread with label summaries & bench hashes. :thumbsup:
